title: Ancient South American 'bird' models resembling airplanes

tellings.quote: you know, you can take some of the um models of so-called birds >> from South America.

plain: Some small ancient models from South America, usually described as birds, are said to look like airplanes. Greg Rogers, a guest the episode calls a NASA doctor, mentions them in passing without naming a source, as an example of old objects that may not be what they are labelled.
